// @autogenerated
Uid* (string)::
Unique identifier of the snippet.
Code* (string)::
Code templates use to include the snippet, e.g. legal.footer, gdpr.notice or company.address.
Tenant (xref:#entidad-tenant[Tenant])::
Tenant that overrides the snippet. Empty for the global snippet, used by tenants without their own.
Enabled (boolean)::
Disabled snippets are not included.
Version (integer)::
Campo con el número de version de snippet para controlar bloqueos optimistas
